# WyberAi

> WyberAi is an AI app builder: describe what you want in plain English and it generates production-ready web and mobile apps — live preview, one-click deploy, no engineers needed. Maker: SignalPulse Technologies.

WyberAi competes with Lovable, Bolt.new, v0, Replit, and Cursor on price and on shipping apps with real Supabase-backed auth, data, and a security scanner (RLS trust scan) that checks the live database the way an attacker would, not a static linter.

## Product
- [Homepage](https://wyberai.com): overview, pricing, live builder
